note: Each case is a valid baseline payload plus one mutation, and must be rejected by the listed schema. These are static contract rejections; they do not prove any runtime authorisation or database behaviour.

cases.name: login-request-self-granted-tenant
cases.reason: tenantId is an unknown client field; the organisation comes from installation configuration

cases.name: login-request-self-granted-roles
cases.reason: roles are server grants and never part of a login request

cases.name: account-create-self-granted-tenant
cases.reason: account creation cannot choose another tenant

cases.name: account-create-self-granted-roles
cases.reason: account creation and role authorisation are separate operations

cases.name: account-create-email-setup-link
cases.reason: the confirmed prototype creates the account with an initial password; no email or one-time-link flow exists

cases.name: account-create-without-initial-password
cases.reason: creation always carries the initial password and the server forces a first change

cases.name: account-update-client-supplied-administrator-state
cases.reason: administrator count and target flag are transaction-time server facts, not client input

cases.name: account-update-empty-intent
cases.reason: an update must change either the display name or the status

cases.name: account-update-conflict-allows-disable
cases.reason: the last-administrator conflict projection can only report the account left active

cases.name: account-update-conflict-zero-administrators
cases.reason: a conflict cannot be reported with zero active administrators

cases.name: role-grant-combined-roles-field
cases.reason: one grant carries exactly one role; operator and platform_admin are independent

cases.name: role-grant-combined-role-value
cases.reason: a combined role string is not a valid role

cases.name: subject-mapping-by-login-name
cases.reason: matching a historical subject by login name is forbidden

cases.name: subject-mapping-without-evidence
cases.reason: explicit mapping requires a verified inventory evidence digest

cases.name: subject-mapping-view-carries-roles
cases.reason: a mapping preserves the subject but never carries or inherits roles

cases.name: session-loa2-from-password-only
cases.reason: urn:ops:loa:2 requires both password and TOTP authentication methods

cases.name: session-first-password-with-business-grants
cases.reason: a first_password_only session must carry no business grants

cases.name: session-csrf-weakened-samesite
cases.reason: the session CSRF cookie is SameSite=Strict

cases.name: session-zero-credential-version
cases.reason: revocation versions start at 1

cases.name: account-view-zero-active-administrators
cases.reason: an account view cannot report zero active administrators

cases.name: admin-password-reset-client-forced-flag
cases.reason: forced first-password change is server policy, not a client flag

cases.name: admin-password-reset-result-zero-credential-version
cases.reason: a reset response must report the new credential version, which starts at 1

cases.name: step-up-verify-client-assurance-level
cases.reason: the client cannot assert an assurance level

cases.name: step-up-verify-client-acr
cases.reason: acr is server output, not request input

cases.name: step-up-create-client-downscales-methods
cases.reason: the server derives required methods from the operation policy; the client cannot request fewer

cases.name: step-up-command-operation-without-command-binding
cases.reason: command execution must bind the real risk assessment, command digest, incident, execution profile version and policy version

cases.name: step-up-user-operation-with-command-binding
cases.reason: user administration must not invent a command risk assessment

cases.name: step-up-mfa-enrollment-target-kind-mismatch
cases.reason: an MFA enrolment challenge must target the enrolment object, not a user

cases.name: step-up-source-operation-with-user-target
cases.reason: a source administration challenge must target the source registration, not a user

cases.name: step-up-verified-single-totp
cases.reason: a single TOTP step does not accumulate a password and cannot become LoA2

cases.name: step-up-verified-without-session
cases.reason: a verified challenge must produce a bound step-up session

cases.name: step-up-verify-result-claims-write-recheck
cases.reason: the pre-write verify response cannot claim a future business-transaction recheck

cases.name: step-up-challenge-verified-partial-methods
cases.reason: a verified challenge must have accumulated both password and TOTP

cases.name: step-up-pending-with-both-methods
cases.reason: a challenge that accumulated both methods is verified, not pending

cases.name: step-up-used-challenge-with-attempts
cases.reason: a used, expired or revoked challenge has no remaining attempts

cases.name: mfa-status-view-repeats-provisioning-uri
cases.reason: the provisioning URI is returned only by the creation response

cases.name: mfa-enrollment-verify-result-without-codes
cases.reason: confirmation issues the recovery code set exactly once

cases.name: mfa-enrollment-verify-short-code
cases.reason: a TOTP code is exactly six digits

cases.name: mfa-enrollment-verify-without-step-up
cases.reason: confirmation must follow a completed password+TOTP challenge bound to this enrolment and session

cases.name: recovery-code-without-challenge-id
cases.reason: the server needs the challenge id to locate the recovery challenge

cases.name: mfa-enrollment-verify-short-recovery-set
cases.reason: the recovery code set contains exactly ten codes

cases.name: recovery-code-without-session-revocation
cases.reason: successful recovery revokes at least one existing session

cases.name: recovery-code-escalates-to-step-up
cases.reason: a recovery code never yields a step-up session or LoA2

cases.name: admin-mfa-reset-result-without-recheck
cases.reason: the reset write must record its own transaction recheck

cases.name: admin-mfa-reset-result-without-revocation
cases.reason: a reset must report the credential and session version bump, even when no session was active

cases.name: write-recheck-command-without-digest
cases.reason: a command-execution recheck must carry the command digest

cases.name: write-recheck-without-write-attempt
cases.reason: a recheck is bound to the actual write attempt

cases.name: observation-create-binds-ai-conversation
cases.reason: a manual observation query must not create or attach to an AI conversation

cases.name: observation-create-free-form-query
cases.reason: only structured filters and fixed templates are accepted

cases.name: observation-create-zero-credential-revision
cases.reason: the source credential revision is required and starts at 1

cases.name: observation-create-non-half-open-window
cases.reason: the window must be absolute and half-open

cases.name: observation-create-without-namespace-uid
cases.reason: a namespaced object requires the namespace name and its UID

cases.name: observation-create-forged-cluster-namespace-uid
cases.reason: a cluster-scoped object must state null namespace and namespace UID, not fabricate one

cases.name: observation-result-total-from-samples
cases.reason: a not-measured population must not carry a total derived from samples

cases.name: observation-result-sample-inferred-population
cases.reason: bounded samples cannot infer a population

cases.name: observation-result-representative-sample
cases.reason: samples are explicitly non-representative

cases.name: observation-result-truncated-without-reason
cases.reason: a truncated result must state why

cases.name: observation-result-complete-without-measured-population
cases.reason: a complete result requires an exact measured population

cases.name: observation-result-no-data-with-samples
cases.reason: no_data means a measured zero population and cannot carry sample rows

cases.name: observation-result-metric-with-log-population
cases.reason: metric, resource and hardware results have no log population; a fabricated count is rejected

cases.name: observation-view-completed-without-result
cases.reason: completed requires a fixed result reference

cases.name: observation-view-terminated-without-receipt
cases.reason: terminated requires a confirmed termination receipt

cases.name: observation-view-cancel-requested-already-terminated
cases.reason: a cancel request is not a termination

cases.name: observation-view-running-with-cancel-flag
cases.reason: cancelRequestedAt only appears after a cancel request state

cases.name: observation-view-running-with-result
cases.reason: a running query has not published a result

cases.name: observation-view-terminated-with-result
cases.reason: a terminated query must not publish a late result

cases.name: observation-view-expired-with-result
cases.reason: an expired read must not expose a stored result

cases.name: observation-reauthorization-allowed-with-denial
cases.reason: an allowed read cannot carry a denial code

cases.name: observation-coverage-unknown-but-complete
cases.reason: unknown coverage basis cannot be reported as complete

cases.name: model-connection-fifth-field
cases.reason: the user configures exactly four fields; runtime tuning is platform managed

cases.name: model-connection-view-echoes-api-key
cases.reason: the API key is never returned after the controlled write

cases.name: model-credential-echoes-secret
cases.reason: the credential state carries no secret material

cases.name: model-admission-without-evidence
cases.reason: admitted requires admission evidence and a frozen profile reference

cases.name: model-unknown-admission-with-profile
cases.reason: an unknown model must not expose a runnable profile reference

cases.name: model-context-window-too-small
cases.reason: the context window has a supported lower bound

cases.name: model-connection-window-client-claims-source
cases.reason: contextWindow input is an integer or null; source and provider maximum are server facts

cases.name: model-credential-replace-without-secret
cases.reason: replace requires the new secret; keep must not resend it

cases.name: model-credential-keep-with-secret
cases.reason: keep carries no secret material

cases.name: model-provider-window-without-measurement
cases.reason: a provider-reported window projection must carry the measured maximum

cases.name: model-test-claims-quality-verdict
cases.reason: a connection test has no quality verdict field

cases.name: model-test-carries-admission-transition
cases.reason: a connection test cannot carry an admission transition

cases.name: model-quality-assessed-without-evidence
cases.reason: an assessed quality verdict requires a rubric version and evidence digest

cases.name: model-run-option-not-ready-worker
cases.reason: only a ready worker may be offered

cases.name: model-run-option-not-admitted
cases.reason: only admitted profiles may be offered

cases.name: model-job-old-contract-version
cases.reason: the new job envelope is explicit; existing job versions are not rewritten

cases.name: model-job-without-admission-evidence
cases.reason: a job freezing a profile must record its admission evidence

cases.name: model-job-without-worker-capability
cases.reason: a job must record the worker capability that can execute the frozen profile
